attributes.residual: TWO INDEPENDENT RESIDUALS, and separating them is the deliverable, because one of them is already solved and the other is the only blocker. RESIDUAL 1, THE BLOCKER, at +0x48: target `addi r3,r31,28`, ours `addi r3,r31,20` -- the pointer to the exception action record handed to `bl __unexpected`. An IMMEDIATE-field difference, so it is outside every postprocessor class by policy and must close at source. NEW FACT, measured by axis 2 and NOT known to the prior record: the padding local is allocated at the TOP of the local block (removing it drops the frame 72 -> 64 and moves the stmw base 56 -> 48) and therefore sits ABOVE the EH record; its size, presence and scope are all incapable of moving the record, which is why all three axes fail in the same way. The record's offset is fixed by whatever occupies the frame between r31+8 and r31+28, and the target has 8 more bytes there than we do while having 8 fewer between the record and the saved registers -- the frames are equal at 72 either way. So the next lever is NOT a bigger or differently-placed pad; it is finding the construct that allocates 8 bytes BELOW the EH record. RESIDUAL 2, ALREADY SOLVED AND WAITING: [0x78,0x88) is a four-atom permutation, ours `[stw r30,12(r28); stw r30,8(r28); lwz r0,76(r31); mr r12,r31]` against the target's `[mr r12,r31; stw r30,12(r28); stw r30,8(r28); lwz r0,76(r31)]`, i.e. order [3,0,1,2] -- the same shape as the shipped __ct__11MoviePlayerFv pin. webfrank.check_permutation_dependences ACCEPTS it in its strictest form (exit_dead=None), and it needs no memory disambiguation because the relative order of the three memory operations is unchanged; only the non-memory `mr` moves. It is deliberately NOT authored: a rule that does not close its function is not a close, and residual 1 is not postprocessor-eligible. CLOSE RESIDUAL 1 AT SOURCE AND THIS FUNCTION IS ONE ALREADY-PROVEN RULE FROM EXACT. Note for whoever takes it: fn_800D96B0 carries the SAME +8 island-slot delta (ours `addi r3,r31,0x18`, target `addi r3,r31,0x20`) and PlayVQMovie carries three r31-relative deltas of +0x1c/+0x18/+0x14, so one mechanism plausibly unlocks three functions.
